هقب: هِقَبْ A word by which a horse is checked, or urged. (K.

هِقَبٌّ Having a large, or ample, throat, (K,) swallowing everything. (TA.) === Large, big, or bulky, and tall, or long; an epithet applied to an ostrich, (Lth, K,) and to other things: (K:) or long, or tall, as an epithet applied to other things than the ostrich. (TA.)
هقبقب: هَقَبْقَبٌ Hard, or firm, and strong, or robust. (K.)
هقور: هِقْوَرٌّ A large, long-bodied man. (Az, in TA, voce هِرْدَبَّةٌ.)
